tiers.name: Default GID_INDEX=0 (RoCEv1 L2) Across L3 Leaf Router -> Silent NET/Socket Fallback
tiers.note: GID 0 is non-routable L2 RoCEv1 (dropped at L3 Leaf switch) or Calico/docker0 hijacks OOB socket -> falls back to 25G TCP NET/Socket (1.8 GB/s, 211x slower)!

tiers.name: GID_INDEX=3 (RoCEv2 IPv4) Without NCCL_IB_TC (Default TC=0 Lands in Lossy Queue 0!)
tiers.note: Connects over RDMA, but TC=0 (DSCP 0) bypasses lossless PFC Priority 3 and lands in lossy best-effort Queue 0 -> severe incast drops (24.5 GB/s)!

tiers.name: Hardcoded GID_INDEX=3 + NCCL_IB_TC=106 (Fragile on Dual-Stack IPv6 GID Table Shift)
tiers.note: Hits lossless Queue 3 (362 GB/s), but if IPv6 link-local addresses shift RoCEv2 IPv4 from GID 3 to GID 5 on 1 node, ibv_modify_qp fails!

tiers.name: Auto RoCEv2 IPv4 GID Pinning + NCCL_IB_TC=106 (cma_roce_tos) + IFNAME Filter + NET/IB Assert
tiers.note: Dynamically resolves the exact RoCEv2 IPv4 GID index, enforces DSCP 26 (TC=106) in both NCCL & rdma_cm, and blocks NET/Socket fallback -> 380.0 GB/s!
